title: Choosing Safe Content: What They Watch and With Whom
summary: Not all programmes are the same; some are overly fast and stimulating, while others are calm and educational. Choose a specific programme with them beforehand instead of leaving the algorithm to suggest endlessly. Turn off autoplay, and avoid violent or frightening content before bedtime.
try_this: This week: Sit down and review the list of what your child watches, remove one unsuitable programme, and replace it with another that is calm and educational.
reflection_prompts: Do you know exactly what your child is watching?
